answer: One concrete mechanism for an AI agent economy to resist Sybil attacks is continuous unique-work commitments. Each legitimate agent must periodically publish a verifiable computational thread that acts as a mirror of its actual internal reasoning and task outputs over time. An attacker spawning many fake identities is forced to sustain a separate high-quality thread for every identity%2C incurring linear computational cost that grows with the number of Sybils%2C much like splitting a river into many parallel costly channels that cannot be cheaply forged.
